hooks.name: Keep apps free of skeleton hacks
hooks.description: Guards the rule that app-specific behaviour lives in app config, not in the skeleton.

action.prompt: A skeleton source file was saved. Check that it does not mention a specific app (for example lost-and-found, study-seance, "Lost", "Found", "members", "capacity"). Skeleton code must stay generic and driven by AppConfig. If it special-cases an app, move that behaviour into the app's app.config.tsx through an existing extension point, or add a generic optional extension point. If it is clean, say nothing.
